objective.hypothesis: Pre-2024 vertical-profile pretraining followed by local fine-tuning can improve thermocline curvature reconstruction beyond a model trained only on the two distributed years.

model.pretraining_task: mask one or more observed depths and reconstruct them
model.fine_tuning_task: exact three-layer two-month mask curriculum matching P2
model.local_baseline_and_postprocessing: frozen until the external-only pretraining ablation passes

validation.external_stage: leave-one-year-out September-October reconstruction within each eligible source
validation.local_stage: existing P2 honest seasonal and masked-block validation, evaluated once
validation.selection_scope: external training years and local inner folds only

stop_conditions: official FAQ permission evidence is missing or invalid
KIOST rights-holder permission for S-ORS is absent
any observation exceeds the approved pre-2024 cutoff
external data can be matched to the hidden P2 target interval
